title: Command handling
description: Admits and dispatches supported command requests and presents their actual scoped results, help and diagnostics.
responsibilities: Admit commands, versions, selectors, and explicit inputs under the selected public contract.
Dispatch operational-record requests to their persistence contract and installation requests to the installation contract without making engineering judgments.
Present bounded observations, diagnostics, omitted-detail access, and exit outcomes without hiding actual side effects or sensitive information.

Select recorded changes and requested record projections under literal public query rules; preserve complete-source and omission distinctions and handle bounded private invocation diagnostics under the owning CLI contract.

Prepare the mandatory bounded public receipt from exact candidate/storage facts before publication, and preserve the actual committed, unchanged, conflict, preview, or recovery outcome through reporting failures.

Realize the command behavior of IF-004 under MOD-018 contract accountability, composing IF-003 record services and IF-006 installation services. This behavioral responsibility does not create a second Interface provider.
Admit proposed browser generation/check/recovery requests under IF-004 and compose IF-012 results without claiming support from repository-only scripts.

For designed relationship traversal, pass the exact selected request to IF-013 and preserve complete, bounded, incomplete and rejected results, source identity and diagnostics; do not infer engineering judgment from dispatch success.
For the separately proposed history query, admit explicit project/subject/filter/page scope and preserve IF-003 state, completeness, conflicts and bounded results under history-selection.md.
owned_state: Admitted command context, rendered results, and optional bounded private invocation diagnostics under the current logging contract; authoritative project records and installation destinations have separate owners.

includes: Published command admission, scoped access, dispatch, results, and diagnostics.
excludes: Inferring authoritative workflow decisions, accepting REM authoring JSON as current operational records, granting authority, or treating successful parsing as a committed update.

design_limits: Existing CLI public envelopes, version domains, selectors, and exceptional command behavior remain specified by design/architecture/modules/MOD-018-engineering-operations/modules/MOD-010-engineering-command-interface/command-contract.md; the new logical Interfaces summarize responsibility and preserve that authority.

IR-008 SR-040 through SR-047 have draft allocated obligations and a reviewed logical composition through IF-003/IF-004. The subordinate realization records a bounded source inspection and proposed choices; installation dispatch under IR-010/IF-006, implementation qualification, and public adoption remain separate work.
IF-013 is a proposed semantic cooperation contract; command syntax, executable availability and qualification are not added to the current operational CLI by this design.

AR-087 defines proposed history admission/presentation only; existing public grammar has no new command or implicit cursor. Capability advertisement requires separately qualified profile and complete cooperating writer support.

sources.basis: Proposed responsibility derived from the published-product source inventory. Existing Designs retain their detailed contracts; this allocation is not a runtime migration or approval.

Allocate the published CLI obligations while preserving this primary responsibility boundary. Receipt cooperation, state custody, and explicit recovery do not expand engineering authority or change runtime behavior.

Apply refined REM Architecture Design through subordinate observed and proposed views. Preserve the logical allocation, existing public contracts, and draft status; source mapping is not executed satisfaction evidence.

Refine contract accountability: MOD-018 provides IF-004 and MOD-019 provides IF-006. MOD-010 and MOD-014 retain their behavioral allocations and state responsibilities. This supersedes the provider/exposure choice recorded by SRC-MODULE-HIERARCHY without changing Interface guarantees, consumers, Function/AR allocations, or realization observations. Earlier source entries retain their prior design meaning; this draft refinement supplies no runtime adoption or satisfaction evidence.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.

Derive selected-state traversal responsibility, admission/completeness outcomes and necessary allocation from existing obligations. Proposed architecture only; no implementation, verification or satisfaction claim.

Define recorded subject association, coherent bounded history selection and state-bound continuation through existing command/storage owners. Target Design only; current ordinary queries, schema and installed capability remain unchanged.
